definition_zh: 欢快的；无忧无虑的；快活的
definition_en: cheerful and carefree in a lively way
core_image: 赤脚跑过草地的孩子在吹蒲公英
scene: 孩子们光脚跑过草地，笑声一路散开。The village fair had a blithesome spirit all day.
sceneCN: 这里 blithesome 是「欢快的」（第 1 个义项：充满轻快愉悦之气）；句意是村里的集市整日洋溢着欢快的气氛。

derivatives.zh: 词根形容词，义为「快活的；漫不经心的」
blithe 加 -ly，义为「快活地；满不在乎地」
blithe 加 -ness，义为「快活；漫不经心」

senses.title: Full of cheerful liveliness
senses.definitionCN: 展现出活泼明快的快乐
senses.example: The village fair had a blithesome spirit all day.
senses.exampleCN: 村里的集市整日洋溢着欢快的气氛。
senses.why: Old English blithe meant glad, and -some adds the air of being full of it.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 blithe 意为「喜悦」，后缀 -some 表示「充满」。

senses.title: Carefree without worry
senses.example: Those blithesome summer days asked nothing of us.
senses.exampleCN: 那些无忧无虑的夏日对我们别无所求。
senses.why: Gladness without weight is the old blithe core.
senses.whyCN: 没有重量的快乐正是 blithe 的古老内核。

senses.title: Light in mood and movement
senses.definition: light and airy in manner or motion
senses.example: Her blithesome step matched the spring morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她轻快的脚步与春日的清晨相配。
senses.why: Joy lightens the body; the word catches it in the step.
senses.whyCN: 快乐使身体变轻，词语在脚步中将其捕捉。

senses.title: Sung or written in gay spirits
senses.definition: of songs or writing, gay and light in tone
senses.definitionCN: 歌谣或文章情调明朗轻快
senses.example: The poet's blithesome verses charmed the court.
senses.exampleCN: 诗人欢快的诗章令宫廷倾倒。
senses.why: Tone can carry gladness as surely as a face can.
senses.whyCN: 文调承载喜悦，正如面容承载笑容。

senses.title: Blissfully untroubled by consequence
senses.definition: cheerful in a way that ignores what may follow
senses.example: He gave a blithesome shrug and signed the paper.
senses.exampleCN: 他快活地一耸肩，签了那份文件。
senses.why: Blithe's modern shade of carelessness is inherited here.
senses.whyCN: 此处承袭了 blithe 现代义中「漫不经心」的色彩。

senses.title: Of gatherings, mirthful
senses.definition: of company or gatherings, merry and animated
senses.example: The wedding was a blithesome affair from noon to night.
senses.exampleCN: 这场婚礼从正午欢腾到深夜。
senses.why: Gladness shared becomes an atmosphere the word can name.
senses.whyCN: 众人共享的喜悦凝成氛围，此词便为其命名。

senses.title: Youthful innocence of spirit
senses.definition: having the innocent gaiety of youth
senses.definitionCN: 带着青春特有的天真快乐
senses.example: There was something blithesome in her schoolgirl chatter.
senses.exampleCN: 她的少女闲谈里透着一股烂漫劲儿。
senses.why: Unburdened youth is the natural home of light gladness.
senses.whyCN: 无重负的青春是轻快喜悦的天然居所。

senses.title: Nostalgically happy in memory
senses.definitionCN: 被追忆为明亮快乐的时光
senses.example: She spoke of her blithesome years on the farm.
senses.exampleCN: 她谈起在农场度过的那些快活岁月。
senses.why: Memory filters out weight and keeps the light.
senses.whyCN: 记忆滤去重量，只留下光。

intro.en: Blithesome doubles the old word blithe with the suffix -some.
intro.cn: blithesome 由古词 blithe 加后缀 -some 构成。

items.en: a reconstructed root blith- meaning gentle, glad; the Norse blithr is a cousin.
items.cn: 重构词根 blith- 意为「温柔的、喜悦的」，古诺斯语 blithr 为其同族。
古英语 blithe 意为「温柔的、快乐的」。

items.en: blithe kept the merry sense in poetry and song.
items.cn: 中古英语时期 blithe 在诗歌歌谣中保留「欢欣」义。

items.en: blithesome formed with -some for a fuller, more festive tone.
items.cn: 18 世纪加 -some 构成 blithesome，语气更为节庆化。

items.en: now literary; blithe is the common form, often with a careless shade.
items.cn: 今属文学用语；常用形式是 blithe，且常带漫不经心之意。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the blith- root; the near-meaning group gathers cheerful words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 blith- 词根；近义组收欢快类词。

entries.definitionCN: 快活的；漫不经心的——同根基础词
柔韧的——拼写相近，词源不同

normalIntro.en: Blithesome is blithe plus -some, brimming with gladness.
normalIntro.cn: blithesome 即 blithe 加 -some，满溢喜悦。

normal.en: It is a literary, old-fashioned choice.
normal.cn: 它是文学化、略古雅的选词。

normal.en: Blithe today often means careless, too.
normal.cn: blithe 今常兼指漫不经心。

normal.en: Pronounce the th as in thy.
-some here means full of, as in winsome.
normal.cn: 此处 -some 意为「充满」，同 winsome。

abstract.en: See children racing barefoot through wet grass.
abstract.cn: 看孩子们赤脚跑过湿草地。

abstract.en: Hear laughter that starts one person and catches the whole room.
abstract.cn: 听一个人的笑声点燃整间屋子。

abstract.en: Feel a summer afternoon with nothing at all to do.
abstract.cn: 感受无事可做的夏日午后。

examples.en: The village fair had a blithesome spirit all day.
examples.cn: 村里的集市整日洋溢着欢快的气氛。

examples.en: Her blithesome step matched the spring morning.
examples.cn: 她轻快的脚步与春日的清晨相配。

examples.en: She spoke of her blithesome years on the farm.
examples.cn: 她谈起在农场度过的那些快活岁月。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不来惹」——他成天乐呵呵的无忧无虑，连烦恼都不来惹他。

root: 古英语 blithe「温柔的、快乐的」，出自重构的日耳曼词根 blith-（与古诺斯语 blithr 同族）；18 世纪加形容词后缀 -some 构成 blithesome「欢快的」，今属文学用语。

sensesIntro.en: From the old gladness of blithe, blithesome paints joy at its lightest and fullest.
sensesIntro.cn: 承自古词 blithe 的喜悦，blithesome 描绘最轻盈、最饱满的快乐。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: barefoot children chasing dandelion seeds
core.cn: 核心意象：赤脚孩子追着蒲公英的种子跑

branches.en: Lively joy in people and gatherings
Gay tone in art and song
branches.cn: 艺术歌谣中的明朗情调
存于记忆中的快乐时光

intro.en: The blith- root pairs with the native suffix -some.
intro.cn: blith- 词根与本土后缀 -some 搭配。

latinIntro.cn: 日耳曼词根，无拉丁同族词。
